purpose: Three rigid parallax planes in each original painting; no per-pixel warping or page layout changes.
compositing: Original pixels are used for visible cutouts; generated plates fill only disocclusions. Foreground mattes are not dilated, avoiding a carried-over background rim. No synthetic silhouette shadows are applied. Cord and Tenzo far openings are traced in gallery-depth.ts to avoid the automatic mask classifying architectural gaps as sky. Tenzo lower floor is united with the banquet.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a far-background reveal plate for the School of Athens image. Remove all living people, all foreground stairs, statues, and the large surrounding vaulted room/arches; inpaint these removed parts by extending the DISTANT pale stone building and blue/cloud sky outward across the canvas. Preserve the complete canvas framing and original distant-building perspective and colors; do not zoom into the building. Use case: background-extraction. Create an exact aligned THREE-COLOR segmentation mask of this School of Athens image, preserving the entire original framing and coordinates. ONLY three flat colors, no shading, texture or outlines. PURE WHITE #FFFFFF: ALL living human figures, their hair, clothes, hands, books and the little desk held/used by the seated man at lower center. Do NOT include the stairs or floor in white. MEDIUM GRAY #808080: all foreground floor, stairs, major surrounding architecture, main vaulted arch, statues, side columns and ornament. PURE BLACK #000000: ONLY the distant building and open sky visible INSIDE the central rear arch opening (behind Plato and Aristotle), from the small blue-sky opening at the center down through the distant facade. The nearer main arch's curved underside stays GRAY. Accurately trace every silhouette at its original position, including gaps between people's legs. All figures are white, not the floor. Black far region, gray middle architecture and white people must tile the complete image. No artistic reinterpretation, no crop, no perspective change. It is a precise compositing matte, not a depth gradient. Output is exclusively a flat technical selection mask for an art-history website, not a rendered painting or depiction of bodies.

WHITE #FFFFFF: the entire LOWER banquet ensemble below the terrace balustrade, including guests, musicians, tables, tablecloths, dogs, vessels, seats and the foreground floor below them; trace the uppermost heads of these LOWER guests, starting roughly 60 percent down the picture. Three entirely flat colors only, no gradients or texture, no black outlines inside the white banquet. No recropping or perspective changes. Detailed accurate edges, not approximate horizontal strips. This is a segmentation matte for separate rigid parallax layers. Output is exclusively a flat technical selection mask for an art-history website, not a rendered painting or depiction of bodies.
